newsitem.title: USA: Silas Creek Retail files Chapter 11 bankruptcy.
newsitem.headline: Silas Creek Retail files Chapter 11 bankruptcy.

text.p: Silas Creek Retail Inc and Silas Creek Retail LP filed for Chapter 11 protection from creditors Wednesday in U.S. Bankruptcy Court in Delaware.
In court papers, Silas Creek Retail Inc, the general partner which also operates as Piece Good Shops Corp, listed assets of $8.5 million and liabilities of $36.4 million.
Silas Creek Retail LP listed assets of $71.2 million and liabilities of $59.8 million.
Both companies named the same 20 largest unsecured creditors, all of them trade claims.
Silas LP is a fabrics and crafts retailer with approximately 200 stores. At least 20 percent or more of Silas Inc is owned by Prudential Insurance Co of America, court papers say.
According to a report in the November 19 Florida Times Union, Piece Goods had planned to close all its Florida shops.
No one could be reached for comment at Silas Creek's headquarters in Winston-Salem, North Carolina.
